scenario.name: Test: Java JDWP debug agent exposed
scenario.author: Thomas Haw
scenario.description: Single-VM scenario used to exercise the java_jdwp_exposed module's secgen_test through tiers 1 and 2 via the Proxmox QEMU Guest Agent pipeline: a Debian 12 Bookworm target running a small Java service under systemd with the JDWP debug agent bound to all interfaces on port 8000. Tier 3 (MSF exploit/multi/misc/java_jdwp_debugger) is wired in later by the driver, which adds a Kali/MSF attacker on the same private network.
